The player character, a sniper, is moving through the bottom lane. (2) Combat intensifies as the player uses skills, resulting in bright blue and yellow visual flashes on the screen. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice initiates energetic narration with high arousal and rapid speech. A consistent electronic BGM bed at approximately 128 BPM plays in the background with a strong 4/4 beat. Frequent digital UI 'pings' and game combat sounds (explosions, projectile whooshes) occur alongside his commentary. (2) As the gameplay intensifies, the narrator's vocal pitch rises and exhibits high variability, reacting to specific in-game movements. Kill notification SFX and gold collection sounds punctuate the mix, distinct from the ongoing electronic synth pads and percussion. (3) The phase concludes with the speaker shouting excitedly, 'Wow, it's over!' with a very high pitch contour. The game's victory/end-screen sound effect triggers, overlapping with the final rhythmic beat of the BGM before the clip cuts.
